premise.claim: DataLoad and DataBackup pods for Alluxio always used the controller's IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS and ignored the AlluxioRuntime's spec.imagePullSecrets, so a DataLoad on a runtime whose images live in its own private registry couldn't pull the image (issue #6247).
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/ddc/alluxio data_load.go / backup_data.go (DataLoad, DataBackup value generation)
premise.evidence: On base ff99142f the runtime-secrets contract tests fail (dataload/databackup value files contain no imagePullSecrets when only the runtime sets them); on head 34a7318 they pass. See results/base-harness.txt vs results/head-harness.txt.

liveNote: L3 not run (skipped per debate setup): on a real cluster, create an AlluxioRuntime with spec.imagePullSecrets and no controller IMAGE_PULL_SECRETS, run a DataLoad, and check the loader job's pod spec lists the runtime secret (PR section IV).
